title: Security: Potential Use-After-Free in CallbackLayerAnimationObserver::OnDetachedFromSequence
description_snippet:
# Steps to reproduce the problem
The bug was found by static analysis, so there is no poc yet. However, prior bug fix https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src.git/+/5145254581a162ae9ad9c1f4f77d54a23c30af86%5E%21/#F1 suggests that it might be a UAF. So, I'm asking for your manual intervention.
